extension_policy.purpose: Reusable, explicit classification decisions for already-approved source classes (RECONCILIATION.md section B). A policy only ever *reuses* a decision an owner already made -- it never grants a new one.
extension_policy.matching: path_patterns are glob patterns (fnmatch semantics) matched against the full repo-relative path. No substring/keyword matching against arbitrary path text is permitted here -- that is exactly the failure mode this registry exists to replace.
extension_policy.eligible_target: a decision.*/layer.* node id this policy's matches are attributed to for traceability. Not required to already exist as a loaded catalog node -- a policy MAY be added in the same PR as, or before, the node it references. When null, this policy is mechanical-only (no node to register into) and auto_registration_allowed must be false.
extension_policy.target_field: the exact code_paths/test_paths array a matched path is registered into when auto_registration_allowed is true. Required whenever eligible_target is non-null; must be null when eligible_target is null. Never inferred from filename/path prose -- always an explicit, owner-authored field on the policy.
extension_policy.policy_version: a positive integer, bumped by an owner whenever this policy's predicate/scope changes meaningfully. reconcile.py's revalidation pass re-runs every already-registered path's predicate the moment its stored policy_version no longer matches this value -- POLICY CHANGE REVALIDATES HISTORY, not just future matches. A structural/content predicate for the id must exist in tools/context_librarian/policy_validators.py before auto_registration_allowed may be true for it.
